question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The enthusiastic readers are __eagerly waiting of the quick__ completion of her forthcoming novel.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment **“eagerly waiting of the quick__”** contains a prepositional error.

 __
 
• “Waiting of”- **INCORRECT**.
 
• **“Waiting for”- CORRECT.**
 
• **Example: **She will **wait for** the bus at the usual stop.
 
 
 
• The other options are grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct sentence is *“The enthusiastic readers are **eagerly waiting for the quick__** completion of her forthcoming novel.”* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__ **

 
• Both **"Wait for"** and **‘Await’ **mean to stay or remain in expectation of someone or something.
 
• **'Await'** is often used in a more formal context. We **do not **use** 'for'** after **'await'.**
 
 
• **Example:** He awaited the results of the medical test with anxiety.
 
• **Example: **He waited for the results of the medical test with anxiety.
